summary: @servicetitan/kendo-theme preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package is published as a Kendo CSS theme (main is dist/index.css; src/ contains only.scss files) but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-bundled, heavily obfuscated JavaScript payload (tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a `WV8StW` string-array shift-rotation decoder over a ~1000-entry dictionary and hex-mangled identifiers). A CSS theme package has no functional reason to install a second language runtime and execute an opaque JS bundle at install time. The mismatch between the package's declared purpose and its shipped executable behavior, combined with the alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to bypass Node-only scanners, is consistent with a malicious or compromised publish into the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
